title: Meta Ad Library Scraper Input Schema

search_keyword.title: Search Keyword
search_keyword.description: Keywords to search in Meta Ad Library (e.g. 'AI UGC', 'Shopify dropshipping', or brand names).

page_urls.title: Facebook Page URLs or IDs
page_urls.description: List of Facebook Page URLs (e.g. https://www.facebook.com/Nike) or numeric Page IDs to scrape ads for.

limit.title: Maximum Ads to Scrape
limit.description: The maximum number of ads to retrieve. Defaults to 20.

country_code.title: Country
country_code.description: Target country code for ads. Use 'ALL' for worldwide reach.

is_active.title: Ad Status
is_active.description: Filter ads by active status or retrieve both.

ad_type.title: Ad Category
ad_type.description: General commercial ads or political/issue ads.

downloadMedia.title: Download Media Assets (Archive to Key-Value Store)
downloadMedia.description: If enabled, binary video (.mp4) and image (.jpg/.png) assets will be downloaded and archived permanently into Apify Key-Value Store. If disabled (default), direct live CDN URLs are saved for free without incurring Key-Value storage costs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. We strongly recommend Apify Residential Proxy (RESIDENTIAL group) to prevent Facebook IP blocks and bot challenge screens.

access_token.title: Meta Graph API Access Token (Optional)
access_token.description: Optional official Meta Graph API token for users with Meta Developer Ad Library access.
